reuse.why: Calls the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, link.findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse and syncAccount, but the link flow and the download function are rewritten as fresh per-provider copies rather than through any shared linking/downloading routine (none exists, and none is introduced).

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount/linkSimpleFinAccount (~65 lines) and downloadFintegraTransactions copies downloadAkahuTransactions (~35 lines), adding a sixth copy of each pattern.

placement.why: Link handler in accounts/app.ts, downloader and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, URL in server-config.ts and account type in types/models, exactly where the tree keeps each provider's pieces.

scope.why: Focused on the Fintegra server path; the two desktop-client edits are forced by extending SYNC_PROVIDERS (Record<BankSyncProviders,...> satisfies), which slightly crosses the 'server only' boundary but minimally.

maintainability.why: Easy to read because it follows the existing per-provider convention, but every future change to linking or downloading must now be made in one more copy.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared link/download abstraction exists in the tree; the existing helpers (assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, handleSyncResponse) are used.

disguised_duplication.where: The copies of linkAkahuAccount (app.ts linkFintegraAccount) and downloadAkahuTransactions (sync.ts downloadFintegraTransactions) are verbatim with names changed, not disguised.
